scripts.build:prompts: sh -c 'if test -f ../../eliza/packages/prompts/scripts/generate-plugin-prompts.js; then node ../../eliza/packages/prompts/scripts/generate-plugin-prompts.js ./prompts ./typescript/generated/prompts --target all; elif test -f ../../packages/prompts/scripts/generate-plugin-prompts.js; then node ../../packages/prompts/scripts/generate-plugin-prompts.js ./prompts ./typescript/generated/prompts --target all; else echo "Prompt generation skipped"; fi'
scripts.build: npm run build:prompts && bun run build:ts && bun run build:rust && bun run build:python
scripts.build:python: test -n "$SKIP_PYTHON_BUILD" && echo 'Python build skipped (SKIP_PYTHON_BUILD set)' || (test -d python && cd python && (timeout 120 python3 -m build 2>/dev/null || timeout 120 pyproject-build 2>/dev/null) || echo 'Python build skipped or timed out')
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:rust && bun run test:python
scripts.test:integration: elizaos test || echo 'Integration tests skipped - elizaos CLI not available'
scripts.build:rust: test -d rust && cd rust && cargo build --release || echo 'Rust build skipped - no rust directory'
scripts.test:rust: test -d rust && cd rust && cargo test || echo 'Rust tests skipped'
scripts.lint:rust: cd rust && cargo clippy --all-targets --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged -- -D warnings && cargo fmt
scripts.lint:python: cd python && ruff check --fix . && ruff format .
scripts.test:python: test -d python && cd python && tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && python3 -m venv "$tmpdir" && "$tmpdir/bin/python" -m pip install -e '.[dev]' -q && "$tmpdir/bin/python" -m pytest -p no:anchorpy --asyncio-mode=auto; status=$?; rm -rf "$tmpdir"; exit $status
scripts.typecheck:python: cd python && python3 -m mypy elizaos_plugin_discord || echo 'mypy not installed, skipping typecheck'

DISCORD_API_TOKEN.description: Discord API token used to authenticate and log in the Discord client/service.

DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.description: Discord application ID for the bot

CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated list of Discord channel IDs that will be parsed into an array if provided.

DISCORD_TEST_CHANNEL_ID.description: Discord channel ID used during test suite to locate the test channel for sending messages, voice interactions, and other test operations.

DISCORD_VOICE_CHANNEL_ID.description: ID of the Discord voice channel the bot should join when scanning a guild. If not supplied, the bot selects a channel based on member activity.

DISCORD_SHOULD_IGNORE_BOT_MESSAGES.description: If true, the bot will ignore messages from other bots. Can be overridden by character settings.

DISCORD_SHOULD_IGNORE_DIRECT_MESSAGES.description: If true, the bot will ignore direct messages. Can be overridden by character settings.

DISCORD_SHOULD_RESPOND_ONLY_TO_MENTIONS.description: If true, the bot will only respond when explicitly mentioned. Can be overridden by character settings.

DISCORD_LISTEN_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated list of Discord channel IDs where the bot will only listen (not respond).
